resources.string: ADOS talks to the flight controller as ground station 1. Failsafe heartbeats, RC overrides and manual control are only accepted from this ID.
If the link to ADOS is lost, the drone flies back along its flown path (SmartRTL), or lands if it cannot.
Seconds of lost link before that failsafe acts.
Losing the RC transmitter also returns along the flown path, or lands.
If guided commands from ADOS stop for this long, the flight controller stops the drone instead of carrying on with the last command.
Stick input sent by ADOS expires after this long, so a stalled app or link cannot keep holding the sticks.
On low battery the drone returns home.
On critical battery the drone lands where it is.
The flight controller\'s own path planner stays off. ADOS plans around obstacles, and two planners would fight.
Turns on the flight controller\'s proximity stop as a backstop under the ADOS brake.
Where the backstop stops: inside the ADOS obstacle margin, so ADOS brakes first.
The backstop stops in front of an obstacle instead of sliding along it.
The flight controller reads obstacle distances from ADOS Navigation over MAVLink.
Memory for the flown path, so a return can retrace it.
How closely the return path is recorded. In a confined place it must be 0.2 m or less so the return stays clear of walls.
Softens attitude changes so the fixed camera does not jerk, while braking stays within the ADOS stopping budget.
Lets ADOS command thrust directly during a supervised lift-off. Manual flight is unchanged.
Streams roll and pitch tuning data to ADOS during a supervised lift-off.
Turns on the ground station failsafe: losing the ADOS heartbeat triggers the long failsafe action.
Seconds without the link before the long failsafe acts.
The long failsafe returns to launch.
Guided flight uses VTOL to hover at the target.
Seconds without ADOS setpoints before PX4 takes its failsafe.
If ADOS control is lost, PX4 holds position.
If the data link to ADOS is lost, PX4 returns home.
Seconds without the data link before that return starts.
